sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy is creating a structural moat for local EV battery and component makers, driving sustained demand for climate-tech capital expenditure.
Falling solar module prices and improving grid infrastructure are accelerating utility-scale and C&I adoption in Indonesia, benefiting EPC and O&M providers with recurring revenue.
Global energy storage mandates and Indonesia's push for 23% renewables mix by 2025 are forcing hybrid PPAs and battery co-location, unlocking new annuity-style cash flows for integrated players.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables rally is broadening beyond solar into storage and EV supply chains, with US-listed names leading sentiment. Accumulate VKTR and TOBA on pullbacks, as domestic policy tailwinds and nickel-integrated battery demand provide durable upside. Trim SEDG exposure into strength, given its volatility and US policy uncertainty.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's domestic consumption recovery, driven by stable purchasing power and election-year fiscal stimulus, will sustain mid-cap FMCG outperformance versus US peers.
Small-cap food and beverage players are benefiting from channel expansion into tier-2/3 cities, where per-capita spending growth outpaces urban centers.
Margin recovery in processed foods and personal care is accelerating as input costs (palm oil, sugar) normalize, rewarding companies with pricing power and efficient supply chains.
sectors.ai: Buy selective small/mid-cap consumer names with idiosyncratic catalysts (BIKE, CBUT, KOBX) while staying underweight large-cap staples exposed to US softness; ID outperformance signals domestic demand resilience, but WATCH implies profit-taking risk—rotate into names with volume growth and margin expansion, avoid chasing 25% single-day spikes.
